description: A stereo crossfader that sweeps one knob across up to four sources, or across the channels of one polyphonic cable

params.text: Sets how many sources the sweep runs through, 2, 3 or 4
Sets how many channels of the IN1 cable the sweep runs through, 1 to 16; above 1 the other input jacks are ignored
Sweeps across the sources, 0% at the first and 100% at the last; the coloured marks are the points where two neighbours are at equal level

inputs.text: The left channel of the first source, or the polyphonic cable the sweep runs through when the PLY knob is above 1
The left channel of the second source
The left channel of the third source
The left channel of the fourth source
The right channel of the first source; with nothing patched the left jack of that row is used for both
The right channel of the second source; with nothing patched the left jack of that row is used for both
The right channel of the third source; with nothing patched the left jack of that row is used for both
The right channel of the fourth source; with nothing patched the left jack of that row is used for both
Moves the sweep, a tenth of its voltage added to the xFD knob, with the total held between 0% and 100%

outputs.text: The left channel of the crossfade
The right channel of the crossfade

inputs.4:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the jack to its left.
inputs.5:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack to its left.
inputs.6:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack to its left.
inputs.7:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack to its left.
inputs.8:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
